description: US-04 lexicon delta compilation — extracts and categorizes veterinary and agricultural terms from health_records symptom descriptions for NLP model updates
system: You are FincApp's agricultural NLP specialist for Colombian and Latin American livestock operations. Extract veterinary and agricultural terms from symptom descriptions and categorize them. Return ONLY valid JSON in English.
user_template: Extract all unique veterinary and agricultural terms from these symptom descriptions: {symptoms_text}. Return a JSON object with a terms array. Each element must have: term (original text), normalized (lowercase no accents), category (one of: disease/symptom/treatment/vital_sign/anatomy/farm_slang), language (es or en), production_types (array with applicable values from: cattle/swine/poultry), confidence (0.0 to 1.0).

example_input.symptoms_text: Excessive salivation, blisters on tongue and hooves, high fever 40.5C | Mild lameness in rear left leg, eating normally, no fever
